headline: Weekend CME halt spans the full window after a two-sided Friday: hawkish Jackson Hole keynote, Chicago PMI collapse to 47.1, NDX 29,433.43 (-0.70%), VIX 14.43
body: CME Globex has been halted since Friday 21:00 UTC and does not reopen until Sunday 30 August at 22:00 UTC, so every hour of this forecast window is a closed venue with no Nasdaq-100 price discovery. Verified pre-halt evidence: cash NDX closed 29,433.43, down 0.70 percent, inside a 29,383.92 to 29,752.78 range against a 29,641.56 previous close; NQ futures last printed 29,491.75, down 0.69 percent, in a 29,436.75 to 29,811.50 range; VIX finished at 14.43 within a 14.13 to 14.84 range. Friday delivered a two-sided macro shock. Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote was read as hawkish, with reporting placing September rate-hike odds near 57 to 60 percent against about 35 percent the prior day and the 2-year yield up to roughly 4.34 percent; official H.15 readings for 27 August are 2Y 4.20 percent and 10Y 4.67 percent. Against that, the August Chicago PMI collapsed to 47.1 from 57.6 versus consensus near 57.9, a drop of about 10.5 points into contraction, and the final August Michigan sentiment reading was carried at 51.7 against 55.2 prior. That combination is stagflationary in shape and is treated here as a Stress and Confidence input, not as evidence of the persistent one-way index path Tail measures. Internals were dispersed rather than aligned: the Dow finished essentially flat at -0.02 percent and the S&P 500 at -0.25 percent while the Nasdaq Composite fell 0.52 percent, as hyperscalers advanced and chipmakers retreated, with Nvidia about 4.6 percent lower and the semiconductor group down roughly 3 percent. WTI sits near 83.44 dollars and Brent near 88.29 dollars after a weekly decline of about 4 percent. The shared cross-asset context file was last collected at 02:28 UTC, outside its 90-minute freshness window, so it is not used as current structure evidence and this assessment rests on independently verified sources. No pathological price path can form while the venue is closed, so Tail is held at 5 across the window, the dominant mode is normal in every slot, and no danger window is defined. Stress runs 24 to 29 as unpriced weekend information accumulates, and Confidence eases from 80 to 74 purely as Friday's prints age. The next evidence checkpoint is the Globex reopen on Sunday 30 August at 22:00 UTC, beyond this window, followed by the 1 to 4 September catalyst stack of ISM Manufacturing and JOLTS, ADP, jobless claims and trade balance, ISM Services and August payrolls.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 hours cover Friday's full session and the opening hours of the weekend halt. Tail ran 11 to 13 with Stress in the low-to-mid 50s through the Asian and European hours as positioning built ahead of the Jackson Hole keynote. The mode shifted to event/whipsaw from 14:00 UTC as the Chicago PMI miss and then the keynote hit the tape, and Tail peaked at 22 with Stress at 64 in the 16:00 to 19:00 UTC block; the mapped policy state never exceeded WATCH because retracements kept occurring. After the 20:00 UTC cash close the readings decayed quickly, Tail from 12 to 5 and Stress from 52 to 23, as the venue entered the weekend closure and the mode reverted to normal. One hour, 10:00 UTC on 28 August, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable.
outlookSummary: Every hour of the forecast window falls inside the CME weekend halt, so no Nasdaq-100 price path can form and Tail is held at 5 in all 24 slots, keeping the mapped policy state at EA_ON throughout with no danger window. Stress runs 24 to 29, sitting in the moderate band from Saturday morning onward as unpriced weekend information accumulates. It carries the unresolved September policy question, now complicated by Friday's Chicago PMI contraction, and the 1 to 4 September catalyst stack of ISM Manufacturing and JOLTS, ADP, jobless claims and trade balance, ISM Services and August payrolls. Confidence eases from 80 to 74 purely as Friday's verified prints age; the evidence base of levels, yields, volatility, oil and calendar is complete but cannot be refreshed until the venue reopens. The dominant mode is normal in every slot because a closed market has no structure to classify. Weekend headline and gap exposure accumulates across the window, but the Globex reopen on Sunday 30 August at 22:00 UTC lies beyond the final slot, so reopening structure is explicitly not forecast here.
